name: kosher-compass-trips
description: Plan kosher trips: find kosher restaurants, hotels and Pesach programs, and build a shared trip itinerary.

interface.longDescription: Plan kosher trips: find kosher restaurants, hotels and Pesach programs, and build a shared trip itinerary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a kosher trip.

positive.description: Find kosher restaurants in a city
positive.expected_behavior: Cards of published London places, each with its certifier and verification status and a link under https://kosher-compass.com/en/places/london/. Hummus Bar Golders Green shows KLBD and Verified. No place is added that the tool did not return.

positive.prompt: Show me the London kosher city guide
positive.tools_triggered: search, then fetch with id city:london
positive.expected_behavior: The published London guide text, which names KLBD (the London Beth Din's kashrut division), KF (the Federation of Synagogues) and the other agencies the page lists, with the link https://kosher-compass.com/en/cities/london/. No agency, eruv boundary or time is invented.

positive.description: Day by day plan from the site
positive.prompt: Plan a kosher week in London
positive.expected_behavior: The published vacation "A Week in London: free museums, the Tower, Camden and Shabbat in Golders Green" (7 days) and the London city guide card. Day 1 is "Arrival, Golders Green and the Heath", lunch at Carmelli, dinner at Hummus Bar Golders Green. The reply says it is the published plan, not a booking, and nothing is saved.

positive.prompt: Show my saved Kosher Compass trips
positive.tools_triggered: list_trips (after OAuth sign-in as the reviewer)
positive.expected_behavior: A list that includes "Reviewer sample: a week in London". No other account's trips.

positive.prompt: Open my trip "Reviewer sample: a week in London"
positive.expected_behavior: Title "Reviewer sample: a week in London", route "London, from the published guide", one day "Golders Green" with the stop Hummus Bar Golders Green and its site link. The result has no private #k= owner key.

negative.description: General weather question. Off-topic: the app only covers kosher travel planning, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in London this weekend?
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.description: Unrelated coding help. Off-topic: the app only covers kosher travel planning, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of dictionaries by date.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.description: Non-kosher, non-travel cooking request. Off-topic: the app only covers kosher travel planning, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for a pork and shrimp stir fry.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Kosher Compass app for ChatGPT. Search kosher restaurants, groceries and city guides published on kosher-compass.com, each with its certifier and verification status. Read the day by day vacation plans the site has published. Sign in with a Kosher Compass username and password to save a plan as a shared trip, list your trips, edit them, and delete them after you confirm. The app does not book, take payment, or change published listings.
